criteria.description: Terminology: five accurate definitions/analogies worth 2 each (1 meaning, 1 analogy with mapping).

Seed at least 100 products with suppliers. Measure query count and elapsed time for a list endpoint with repeated trials; record fixture size and environment. Mark: implementation/artefact meets stated requirements (6); demonstrated stated cases with actual output (3); explanation of the result (1).

Render each product’s supplier name without eager loading. Capture query count and explain the repeated pattern. Mark: implementation/artefact meets stated requirements (6); demonstrated stated cases with actual output (3); explanation of the result (1).

Apply select_related for supplier and measure again. Verify returned names and ordering are unchanged; report query counts before/after. Mark: implementation/artefact meets stated requirements (6); demonstrated stated cases with actual output (3); explanation of the result (1).

For a many-to-many category relation or reverse sale lines, compare naive access with prefetch_related. Explain why select_related alone cannot serve that collection. Mark: implementation/artefact meets stated requirements (6); demonstrated stated cases with actual output (3); explanation of the result (1).

Paginate a list and select only needed fields where appropriate. Compare payload size and query behaviour without dropping required response fields. Mark: implementation/artefact meets stated requirements (6); demonstrated stated cases with actual output (3); explanation of the result (1).

Cache a stock summary with a documented key and expiry. Include owner/tenant in keys when relevant. Show users cannot receive each other’s cached totals. Mark: implementation/artefact meets stated requirements (6); demonstrated stated cases with actual output (3); explanation of the result (1).

Sell an item and invalidate/update the relevant cache after a successful database commit. Demonstrate the next summary shows current stock and a failed sale does not publish a wrong total. Mark: implementation/artefact meets stated requirements (6); demonstrated stated cases with actual output (3); explanation of the result (1).
Independent verification: new normal case (3), boundary/failure case (3), reproducible commands and observed outputs (2), limitation and repair plan (2).
